gyur to/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' rgyal ba'i blo gros kyis 'dul bar gyur pa7de dag ni〈skyon 'dzin cing skyon rjod pa/ blo mi brtan pa sha stag tu gyur te/ bcom ldan 'das de nas byang chub sems dpa' rgyal ba'i blo gros bsod namasasnyel spyod pa zhig gi tshe/ ma rig nas byang chub sems dpa'aphurab tu dga' ba'i dbang po'i bslang duba'i grong der mchis te/ des de na khyim bdag gi bu'i gnas shig mchis par mthong nas/ khyim bdag gi bu gang na ba der mchis nas phyin pa dang / stan bting ba la mchis te/ khyim bdag gi bu de la 'dod pa chung ba'i bka' mchid khyabarjod/ chog shes pa'i bka' mchid brjod/ sdom pa'i bka' mchid brjod/ 'du 'dzi'i nongs pa brjod/gcig pur dga' ba'i bsngags pa brjod/ 'du 'dzishem mchis pa'i bsngags pa brjod nas/ khyim bdag gi bu de'i mdun du byang chub sems dpa' rab tu dga' ba'i dbang po la mi snyan pa rjod pa dge slong des ni skye bo mang po log par bstan to/ /dge slong des ni skye bo mang po log par lta bar byas so/ /dge slong de ni 'du 'dzi'i nang na rnam par spyod pa ste/ 'dod chags ni sgrib pa med do zhes ston to/ /zhe sdang ni sgrib pa med do zhes ston to/ /gti mug ni sgrib pa med do zhes ston to/ /chos thams cad ni sgrib pa med do ⑧zhes ston to zhes brjod pa dang / khyim bdag gi bu de yang dbang po rno ba bzod pa thob pa zhig ste/ des dge slong de la smras pa/ btsun pa khyod kyis 'dod chags ji ltar mkhyen/ des smras pa/ khyim bdag gi bu 'dod chags ni 0kun nas nyon mongs par shes so/ /smras pa/ btsun pa 'o na 'dod chags de nang na mchis sam / phyi rol na mchis/ smras pa/ 'dod chags ni nang na yang med/ phyi 68—775

rol na yang med do/ /smras pa/ btsun pa de ltar 'dod chags nang na yang ma mchis / phyi rol na yang ma mchis7shar phyogs na yang ma mchis/ lho phyogs na yang ma mchis/ nub phyogs na yang ma mchis/ byang phyogs na yang ma mchis/steng na yang ma mchis/ 'og na yang ma mchis/ phyogs mtshams rnams na yang ma mchis te/ de lta lags na de ni ma skyes pa lags te/ gang lasnyom skyes pa de la kun nas nyon mongs pa'am/ rnam par byang ba'ang ci zhig mchis/ de nas dge slong rgyal ba'i blo gros kyis bstan pa de thos nas 'khrugs te shin tu mi dga' nas / bsod snyoms kyang ma blangs par stan las langs te mchis so/ /'di skad kyi tshig kyang rjod de/ kye ma dge slong des ni/ skye bo mang po log par bstan to zhes kyang brjod dunas de khyim de nas byung ste/ dgon pa logs su mchis so/ /de slad kyis gtsug lag khang du mchis nas dge slong lhag ma rnams la yang bsgo'o④/ /dge 'dun gyisnyinang du yang dge slong de mthong nas/ 'di skad du dge slong 'di ni skye bo mang po log par ston cing / dge slong 'di ni skye bo mang po log par lta bar byed de/ 'di ni 'dod chags sgrib pa med do zhes ston to/ /zhe snang sgrib pa med do zhes ston to/ /gti mug sgrib pa med do zhes ston to/ /chos thams cad sgrib pa med do zhes ston to zhes bgyis so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' rab tu dga' ba'i dbang po de 'di snyam du gyur te/dge slong 'dis ni gdon mi za bar las kyi sgrib pa bsags par gyur gor ma chag na de la bdag gis zab mo'i gtam bya'o/ /des ni ma nus na'ang 'di'i byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams bsgom pa'i rgyu tsam du'ang 'gyur ro snyam ste/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' rab tu dga' ba'i dbang pos/ dge slong gi dge 68—776

'dun thams cad gcig tu 'dun par bgyis nas/ de'i tshetutshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /'dod chags mya ngan 'das par gsungs/ /zhe sdang gti mug de bzhin te/ /byang chub de dag gnas nyid yin/ /sangs rgyas byang chub bsam mi khyab/ /'dod chags gang gis rnam brtags gepa/ /zhe sdang gti mug de bzhin te/ /sangs rgyas byang chub de la ring / /gnam dang sa gnyis cikhubazhin no/ /byang chub 'dod chags gnyis ni gnyis su med/ /'jug pa gcig pa mnyam nyid ldan pa ste/ /'di dag chos la byis pa gang 'jigs pa/ /de dag sangs rgyas byang chub ring ba yin/ /'dod chags skye min 'jig pa ma yin te/ /sems kyang kun nas nyon mongs 'gyur ba med/ /gang zhig dmigs pa'i bdag la blo chags pa/ /'dod chags ngan song de dag ltung bar byed/ /gang zhig 'dod chags chos kyang sangs rgyas chos/ /de dag khyad par gang yang med pa ste//yi ge gcig cing tshul gcig mtshan nyid med/ /de ltar shes pa bde gshegs nyid du 'gyur/ /tshul khrims 'chal dang tshul khrims rnam brtags shing / /gang zhig tshul khrims rlom pas myos7gyur pa/ /dmigs pa'i lta la rab gnas de la ni/ /byang chub med cing sangs rgyas chos kyang med/ /gang zhig dgon pa'i gnas la rtogashebyed cing / /bdag la stodakyibyed gzhan la smodakyibyed pa/ /dgon par lta la rab gnas de la ni/ /mtho ris med na byang chub ga la yod/ /byang chub lta nib gnyis su med gsungs te/ /ming dang yi ge grangs dang sgra 'jug pa/ /de dag gang gis yang dag rtogs gyur pa/ /de la sangs rgyas byang chub ring ba min/ /kun nas nyon mongs de la rnam rtog cing / /rnam byang lta la byis pa gang chags pa/ /dmigs pa'i lta la rab gnas de la ni/ /byang chub 68—777

med cing sangs rgyas chos kyang med/ /gang zhig sangs rgyas chos la 'dod skyedatupa/ /de la sangs rgyas byang chub ring ba ste/ /yod min chos la 'dod pa skyed pasakun/ /de ni sdug bsngal yongs su myong bar 'gyur/ /gang zhig 'dod chags zhe snang mi rtog cing / /gti mug chung bas byang chub yin lta ba/ /de la sangs rgyas byang chub ring ba min/ /bzod pa mchog kyang myur du des 'thob 'gyur / /'dus ma byas dang 'dus byas sus mthong ba/ /de ni 'khor ba'i chos las gzhar7mi 'grol/ /gang gis khams de mnyam pa nyid rtogs pa/ /de myur skyes bu sangs rgyas mchog tu 'gyur/ /gang gis sangs rgyas chos dang sangs rgyas dgadu /thams cad kun tu nam yang ma mthong na/ /chos rnams kun gyis gos pa med pa de/ /bdud bcom byang chub mngon par 'tshang yang rgya/ /su zhig sems can rnam par 'grel 'dod pa/ /des ni sems can khams su blta mi bya/ /ma lus sems can mya ngan 'das dang 'dra/ /de ltar sus shes de ni rang byung 'gyur/ /dgon pa'i chos la gang zhig mi snang zhing / /grong du phyin na spyod lam 'chos7byed pa/ /de ni 'jig rten lhar bcas rkun po ste/ /de la byang chub sangs rgyas chos rnams med/ /bdag ni sangs rgyas 'gyur zhes gang rlom pa/ /byis pa de ni gti mug dbang gis non⑨/ /sangs rgyas chos ni nam mkha' mtshungs pa ste/ /blang dang dor ba'i sgra ni de la med/ /rgyal bas nam yang byang chub sangs ma rgyas/ /des ni nam yang sems can bkrol ba med/ /med pa'i chos rnams brtags〈nyeshing byis pa rnams/ /sangs rgyas byang chub las ni ring ba yin/ /sems can 'di dag nyon mongs sus mthong ba/ /de la nyon mongs mtha' yas 'byung bar 'gyur/ /sems can de dag sems can med ces 68—778

gsungs/ /sems can 'du shes gnas la byang chub med/ /gang gis sems can shin tu grol mthong zhing / /'dod chags zhe snang gti mug rtag med la/ /sems can zhi zhing rab zhi rnam zhi bar/ /gang gis shes pa de ni mgon por 'gyur①/ /gang gis sems can sems can med ma mthong / /yang dag nyid du sangs rgyas chos ma dmigs/ /ji ltar sems can de bzhin sangs rgyas shes/ /de ltar sus shes de ni mgon por 'gyur②/ /nyon mongs rtog na nyon mongs yod par 'gyur/ /tshul bzhin lam sems de bzhin nyon mongs yod/ /nyon mongs lam du nam yang ma brtags na/ /desasheni byang chub mi rtog sa 'thob bo//stong pa'i chos kyis mi mkhas gang 'jigs pa/ /de dag sangs rgyas chos las ring ba yin/ /stong nyid chos la the tsom su med pa/ /de dag sangs rgyas byang chub 'thob par 'gyur/ /byang chub mchog thob par ni su 'dod pa/ /des ni 'dod chags chos la brtag mi bya/ /'dod chags chos kyi mtshan nyid gang yin pa/ /de dag sangs rgyas yon tan bsam mi khyab/ /gang zhig sangs rgyas chos la mi 'jug cing / /sems dang byang chub skye ba med pa dngakyi/ /sems dang sangs rgyas byang chub gnyis med par/ /shes par gyur na de ni mgon por 'gyur/ /sdig sems mu stegs can gyis gang brjod dang / /sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsung gang bka' stsal pa/ /de dag tha dadakhutshul gyur med pa ste/ /de ltar shes na de ①ni mgon por 'gyur/ /gang gis byang chub mthong zhing smon byed pa/ /de dang byang chub ring ste byang chub med/ /sangs rgyas sangs rgyas min pa mi mnyam zhe'am/ /sangs rgyas 'di zhes mi rtog mgon por 'gyur/ /gang zhig bdag ni sems can 'grel pa zhes/ /rlom na sems can 'du shes 68—779

chags rmongs pas/ /dmigs pa'i lta la rab gnas de la ni/ /byang chub med cing sangs rgyas chos kyang med/ /'dod chags nang dang phyi na mi gnas te/ /phyogs dang phyogs mtshams gang na'ang yod pa min/ /chos rnams yod min rnam par brtag byas shing / /byis pa 'dod chags 'du shes de ltar rmongs/ /sgyushem smig rgyu brag ca lta bu ste/ /mo gshamakhubu dang rmi lam 'dra ba ni②/ /nyon mongs 'di dag thams cad dmigs su med/ /byis pa de ltar mi shes rnam par rmongs / /'dus byas chos dang 'dus ma byas kyi chos/ /de dag tha dad gnyis su nam yang med/ /gang la grangs dang bgrang du med pa dngakyi/ /de yi tshul gyis gnyis su med par 'jug /byis pa gang zhig byang chub sems rlom zhing / /sangs rgyas 'gyur zhes rlom sems byed gyur na/ /chos kyi dngos nyid phyag rgya 'di bor bas/ /de la sangs rgyas chos dang byang chub med/ /smra la gang dga' yongs rtog spyod yul can/ /smra ba'i don la rnam par mi sems shing / /ming dang legs la de bzhin chags gyur pa/ /de dag byang chub 'gyur ba the tsom0yodarka/ /lta ba'i rnam pa byang chub gnyis med gsungs/ /ming dang yi ge grangs dang skad 'jug pa⑦/ /mi mkhas gang gis chos 'di ma rtogs pa/ /de dag sangs rgyas byang chub ring bar gnas/ /ming la chags shing smra la dga' ba dang //bdag tu lta la gang zhig gnas gyur cing / /'dod pa chung dngakhuchog shes rnam brtags pas/ /'dod pa'i dbang gis da dung de 'dug go/ /'dod chags chos las shed skyes gang 'bros pa/ /de ni 'dod chags chos las gzhar mi 'grol / /gang gis yang khyadag 'dod chags chos shes na/ /'dod chags bral ba'i 'dod chags chos shes 'gyurngo/ /yun ring dus su tshul khrims bsrung 11—780

byas shing / /bskal pa bye bar bsam gtan bskyed0)byas kyang / /yang dag nyid mtha' 'di ni mashertogs na/ /bstan pa 'di la de dag blo yod min/ /ci yang ma yin chos 'di sus shes pa/ /nam yang de ni chos kun chags mi 'gyur②ske/ /tshul khrims 'chal dang tshul khrims rnam brtags pas/ /byis pa dmigs pa'i spyod yul thar mi 'gyur/ /tshul khrims tshul khrims med par sus5geshes shing / /tshul khrims 'chal dang tshul khrims tshul gcig ces/ /tshul khrims ngang tshul de ltar sus shes pa/ /tshul khrims 'chal5gepa de la nam yang med/ /chos rgyal chos la rtog yipar ma gyur na/ /thabs kyi sa la sems can rnam ⑦'dul zhing / /byang chub zag med zhi ba 'di la yang / /tshul gcig chos kyis sems can 'dzud pa yin/ /chos rgyal dam pa'i chos 'di mi g.yo zhing / /dngos med mtshan nyid med la tshul gcig par/ /ngo bo nyid kyis stong chos ma thos pasabya/ /g.yang sa chen por byis pa de dag ltung / /chos 'di thos shing mi dngangs1)gang gyur pa'i/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga chags khyim pa'ang bla'i( sta/ /bstan pa 'di la rab tu byung gyur cing / /dmigs sta 31sbyangs pa'i yon tan rlom pa min/ /phyogs bcu kun na sangs rgyas rang byung ba/ /'jig rten don mdzad gang dag bzhugs pa rnams/ /de dag kun gyis nam mkha' mtshungs pa'i chos / /g.yo ba med shes byang chub 'gyur zhes gsungs/ /mi mkhas gang rnams mi sdug bsgom sems shing nyurnye/ /chos rab 'di thos 'jigs par 'gyur ba dag /rtag par sdug bsngal che dang ldan gyur cing / /bskal pa bye ba mang por sdug bsngal 'gyur/ /tshigs su bcad pa bstan pa 'di bshad pa'i tshe/ lha'i bu stong phrag sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob bo/ /dge slong stong 68—781

phrag brgyad cu nye bar len pa med par zag pa las sems rnam par grol lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rgyal ba'i blo gros kyang 'chi ba'i dus bgyis nas dog sa'i sgo phye ste/ sems can dmyal ba chen por7ltung ngo / /de sug las kyi sgrib pa des bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya phrag stong du sems can dmyal ba chen po dag tu ②sdug bsngal tsha bzhing rtsub la yid du mi 'ong ba'i tshor ba mi bzad 0pa myong bar gyur to/ /tshe rabs brgya stong phrag bdun cu rtsa bzhir mi snyan par brjod pa thob par gyur to/ /bskal pa brgya stong mang por de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan tsam yang ma thos par gyur to/ /de de nas slad kyis de bzhin gshegs pa gzhan dang gzhan dag dang mjal ⑤te/ de dag gi bstan pa laphurab tu byung nas mngon par mos par ma gyur te/ tshe rabs stong phrag bdun cu rtsa drug rab tu byung ba las slar babs par gyur to/ /sug las kyi sgrib pa de nyid kyi lhag mas tshe rabs stong phrag mang7por dbang ponyertul por gyur to/ /bcom ldan 'das de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' dge slong chos smra ba rab tu dga' ba'i dbang po zhes bgyi ba byung ba de ⑩ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas te/ da ltar bzhugs shing 'tsho gzhes chos kyang ston to/ /shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams bye ba brgya stong 'das pa na / sangs rgyas kyi zhing rin chen sna tshogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gzi brjid stuganyecing dri ma med la nyi zla zil gyis gnon pa bzhugs shing 'tsho gzhes chos kyang ston te⑩ / bcom ldan 'das dge slong rgyal ba'i blo gros zhes bgyi bar gang gyur pa de hunyeni bdag nyid de'i tshe de'i dus na/ dge slong rgyal ba'i blo gros zhes bgyi 68—782

bar gyur te/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gi7de'i tshe tshul 'di ma 'tshalakhubs de lta bu'i sdug bsngal myong bar gyur to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag ni de 'dra ba'i gnas su gyur te/ de lta bu'i sdug bsngal ma mchis pa'i sdug bsngal yongs su brtags pa'i sdug bsngal/ phyin ci log gi sdug bsngal rnam pa de lta bu myong bar gyur to/ /bcom ldan 'das de lta lags pas byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa la zhugs pa'am/ nyan thos kyi theg pa la zhugs pa gang yang rung ste/ de lta bu'i sug las kyi sgrib pa mi 'tshal zhing / de lta bu'i sdug bsngal mi 'tshal na des dam pa'i chos spang bar mi bgyi'o/ /dam pa'i chos la dpya5 bar mi bgyi'o/ /chos gang la yang khong khro bar mi bgyi'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /'jam dpal tshigs su bcad pa de thos pas khyod la khyad par ci zhig tu gyur/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das tshigs su bcad pa de thos pas sug las kyi sgrib pa de las langs nas gang dang gang du skyes pa de dang de dag tu yang zab mo'i bzod pa can/ nges pa'i bzod pa can du gyur te/ chos zab mo ston pa la mkhas par gyur to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'jam dpal su'i mthus khyod kyis de ltar yun ring po na semangon par 'du byas pa'i las kyi sgrib pa rjes su dran/'jam dpal gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni ci sems ci smra/ rjes su ci dran yang de dag thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i mthu ste/ de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa las byung ba ni chos thams cad do/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/'jam dpal de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu thob pa dang / 'di thos pa de 60—783
